subject: Executive review requested — Hosted API rate adjustment for ClearWell pilot
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive review requested — Hosted API rate adjustment for ClearWell pilot

Hi team,

Quick request for executive review and sign-off: ClearWell (prospect) is ready to run a 6-month pilot that we expect to convert to a full enterprise deployment if results meet latency/cost targets. They asked for a 28% unit-rate reduction on our Hosted API usage during the pilot to make the economics work for their finance team.

Key facts:
- Pilot term: 6 months; expected monthly consumption ramp: month1 $8k -> month6 $40k (see attached usage_projection_q3.xlsx)
- Requested rate cut: 28% off standard Hosted API usage price (applies to token generation only)
- Proposed Redwood ask: 12-month commitment (prepay) at 25% off, or 6-month pilot at 28% with a signed conversion MOA to a 12-month reserved commitment at end of pilot.
- Strategic rationale: ClearWell is a well-known payer/health network in the northeast with multi-region expansion plans; marketing partnership and case study likely on conversion.
- Margin impact: Estimated gross margin compression ~12 percentage points at 28% discount during pilot; we can offset ~40% of that via batching/quantization recommendations (see attached SOW).

Attachments: SOW_ClearWell_v1.pdf, usage_projection_q3.xlsx

Ask: Exec authorization for one of the following (please reply with APPROVE/DECLINE/COUNTER and any conditions):
A) Approve 28% off Hosted API usage for 6-month pilot (requires legal SOW + SLA exception; finance to accept pilot prepay of at least 3 months upfront)
B) Approve 25% off for a 12-month prepay commitment (preferred economics)
C) Decline — revert to standard pricing and escalate if ClearWell pushes back

I recommend B as the path that protects unit economics while enabling the commercial signal. If you want the alternative (A) I can add a strict conversion milestone and ROA.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive review requested — Hosted API rate adjustment for ClearWell pilot

Lauren —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick Qs before I weigh in formally:
1) Confirmed ARR/Ramp assumptions and conversion probability? (I want to see expected lifetime value if they convert to Dedicated)
2) Any compliance or SSO/P2P legal asks that could add to onboarding cost?

If margin hits ~12 pts at 28% discount, finance will push back unless we get a prepay + clear conversion clause. If Legal needs an SLA exception that's also a higher bar. Recommend we line-up a short MOA (attached SOW) with a 3-month prepay and a conversion credit if they convert to Reserved capacity within 90 days of pilot end.

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive review requested — Hosted API rate adjustment for ClearWell pilot

Ben —

Answers inline:
1) Conversion probability: Sales forecast at 60% based on exec sponsor and reference request. Expected post-conversion ARR ~ $480k ARR (12 month equivalent) if they commit to multi-region deployment.
2) Compliance asks: Basic SOC2 + IP carveouts; they requested an audit log export cadence and a temporary data-retention tweak during pilot. Legal said those are manageable with a short addendum (low expected cost).

Updated economics attached (Drive link in related_links). My recommended motion is: Approve 25% off for a 12-month prepay (minimum $120k annual commitment) OR approve a one-time 6-month pilot at 28% if we get 3 months prepay and a signed conversion MOA with conversion credits.

If no exec approval by EOD we risk losing momentum — their procurement window closes next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Lauren
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@redwood.ai>, Finance Ops <finance.ops@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive review requested — Hosted API rate adjustment for ClearWell pilot

Team —

I reviewed the ask and the attached SOW + forecast. Given the strategic upside and the reasonable conversion probability, I will approve a limited exception with conditions. Decision below:

APPROVED (conditional) — 25% off Hosted API usage rate for a 12-month prepaid commitment of at least $120,000 (net). Conditions:
- Finance signs off on payment terms (12-month prepay or prepaid quarterly) and accepts a one-time conversion credit structure if they convert to Reserved capacity;
- Legal to include an addendum limiting SLA exceptions to pilot scope and special retention settings;
- Approval is limited to this account and pilot only; no broader precedent to be set;
- Sales to secure exec sponsor confirmation and procurement PO by 2026-07-22.

If Sales can secure the 12-month prepay with those terms, Legal and Finance please prepare the PO and SOW addendum templates and Ben, loop me back with final terms for signature.

Mina
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Sullivan <eric.sullivan@clearwellhealth.com>, Kate Ramos <kate.ramos@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.ai>, Finance Ops <finance.ops@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Executive review requested — Hosted API rate adjustment for ClearWell pilot

Hi Eric/Kate —

Forwarding an approved path for your pilot. Executive decision: Redwood will provide a 25% discount on Hosted API usage for a 12-month prepaid commitment at a minimum $120k net. Legal and Finance are looped to finalize the SOW addendum and payment terms.

Next steps from our side:
1) I will send an updated SOW and PO template for your signature by tomorrow (legal will include the retention addendum)
2) Finance will provide wiring instructions and prepay schedule options (12-month or quarterly prepaid)
3) We will schedule a kickoff call with engineering to confirm ingestion and latency targets

Appreciate the partnership — excited to move forward.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
